item.title: Orthorexia--what is it?
item.description: Maintaining a healthy, balanced diet is something we teach our kids as part of living a happy, healthy lifestyle. However, with social media and influencer culture, there's been a growing push to promote certain eating trends and diets.

item.title: PennDOT announces vehicle restrictions ahead of winter weather
item.description: PennDOT has announced multiple speed restrictions ahead of Tuesday's forecasted winter weather.

item.title: Man enters plea before new trial in child sex abuse material case
item.description: On the day he was set to be retried on four counts of pandering sexually oriented matter involving a minor, Trent Addicott pleaded no contest to the charges.

item.title: New bill introduced for railway safety
item.description: There are three train derailments every day in the USA, and East Palestine lives with the effects every day from a disaster three years ago.

item.title: Man arrested, accused of shooting into occupied home
item.description: A man was arrested last week after he was identified as a suspect involving shots fired into a Warren home with children inside at the time of the shooting.

item.title: Will attacks in Iran affect gas prices?
item.description: Gas prices have been steady in Northeast Ohio this past week, but the recent attacks on Iran could make those numbers climb.

item.title: Niles restaurant planning to reopen after car crashes into it
item.description: A car crashed into Tino's Italian Kitchen in Niles on Friday. The restaurant has been closed since but plans to reopen this week.

item.title: Storm Team 27 recap of this year's winter
item.description: Lightning, thunder, snow and cold. This winter had it all. While it will mostly be remembered for near-constant cold, snow covered the ground more than 75 percent of the past three months.

item.title: Farmington Twp. Fire Department levy back on ballot
item.description: Voters in Farmington Township and West Farmington Village will once again see a 2.9 mills additional continual levy for the Farmington Township Fire Department on the ballot.

item.title: Mayor, Historical Society work to save old train station
item.description: Today it's owned by Norfolk Southern, but it wasn't until two months ago when a dumpster was placed out front with plans to demolish the train station that the people of Greenville decided it was time to save it.
